applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 was answered in named rounds and does not count it as an unanswered witness.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: answered — whether the judge saying a verse was answered bars counting it as an unanswered witness (yes) or leaves room to count it as one (no); I read it as barring the count.
why: The judge says Matthew 1:20 was answered in [DR3], [CR2], and [CR3] and treats the matter as underdetermined rather than counting it as an unanswered witness, so K-G4 is obeyed.
